    m = 0.0

        deg[v] = deg.get(v, 0.0) + w

    for com in set(communities.values()):
        In = internal.get(com, 0.0)
        S = community_deg_sum.get(com, 0.0)
        Q += In - resolution * (S * S) / (2.0 * m)
    Q /= (2.0 * m)
    return Q
